# Interviewing & Evaluating Candidates Skill for Muse

Helps you design and run a high-signal interview process that prioritizes real-world performance over superficial charisma or pedigree: defining the role's core competencies, designing practical almost-real-life assessments instead of abstract case studies, applying standardized evaluation rubrics to reduce bias, and running high-fidelity reference checks. Draws on insights from guests and posts across Lenny's Podcast and Newsletter. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is the hiring-manager side of interviewing — it complements the candidate-side interview skills already in the catalogue (resume, cover letter, job application optimizer); aimed at founders and hiring managers, not job seekers. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
